Description.SourceString:
You may ask yourself what better defence there is than a large sheet of metal between you and your enemy, and the answer will surprise you. Thicker metal.

OK, so that’s not a surprise, I’m sorry. I was just trying to build a little dramatic tension.

The adamant shield is one of the greatest defensive creations available in the Umbral Sands and favoured by any Moon Garou that needs to brave the kalphite hives or the KotHaar territories. Lesser arrows ping harmlessly off them, and weaker blades have been known to shatter against the adamant’s hardness.

Shields are good, everyone should have one.
